entities.summary: Mohamed Hamout is a Moroccan boxer, who has represented his country in international competitions. He competed in the men's bantamweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics, where he lost to Robeisy Ramirez of Cuba in the Round of 16. He also competed in the men's featherweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
